entries.en: The volunteers stacked blankets, folding chairs, spare lamps, etc in the van.
entries.zh: 志愿者把毯子、折叠椅、备用灯等物品堆放进货车。

entries.en: The missing paragraph was restored to chapter XIV of the manuscript.
entries.zh: 缺失的段落已补回手稿的第十四章。

entries.en: Both hands of the clock pointed to XII when the bell rang.
entries.zh: 钟声响起时，两根指针都指向表盘上十二点的位置。

entries.meaningZh: 对罗马天主教等修士的尊称
entries.en: Dom Peter showed the visitors the Benedictine abbey's herb garden.
entries.zh: 彼得修士带领来访者参观本笃会修道院的药草园。

entries.en: For her project on Chinese legends, Mei chose to write about Yu.
entries.zh: 梅在中国传说课题中选择以禹为写作对象。

entries.en: We entered through gate XVI after the queue at the main entrance stopped moving.
entries.zh: 正门入口的队伍停滞不前后，我们从十六号门进去了。

entries.en: She turned to page xiii of the preface to check the editor's acknowledgements.
entries.zh: 她翻到前言的第十三页，查看编者的致谢。

entries.en: The Scots crofter in our historical play calls, "Bring mae logs from the cart."
entries.zh: 在我们的历史剧中，苏格兰佃农喊道：“从车上多拿些木柴来。”

entries.en: "Yuck, there's mould on the inside of this lid!"
entries.zh: “真恶心，这个盖子里面都长霉了！”

entries.en: When the kittens settle beside the warm stove, they begin to pur.
entries.zh: 小猫们在温暖的炉子旁安顿下来后，就开始咕噜咕噜地叫。

entries.en: She earned her JD before applying for work at the legal aid centre.
entries.zh: 她在申请到法律援助中心工作之前，已获得法学博士学位。

entries.en: The receipt was dated 12 Jun, although the parcel had arrived two days earlier.
entries.zh: 收据上写着6月12日，但包裹其实早两天就已送到。

entries.en: "It's nae easy to mend a dry-stone wall in that wind," the Scottish farmer said.
entries.zh: 苏格兰农民说：“刮着那样的风，修干砌石墙可不容易。”

entries.en: "Oui, the spare key is in the blue cupboard," she replied with a nod.
entries.zh: 她点头答道：“是的，备用钥匙在蓝色的橱柜里。”

entries.en: "You can put your tools in my shed, guv," he told his father in his old-fashioned London way.
entries.zh: 他用老派的伦敦口吻对父亲说：“老爸，你可以把工具放在我的棚屋里。”

entries.en: At the little French inn, we ordered some vin to go with the meal.
entries.zh: 在那家法国小客栈里，我们点了些葡萄酒佐餐。

entries.en: The search team found the survey notes in volume XVIII, beneath a loose map.
entries.zh: 搜寻小组在第十八卷一张散页地图的下面找到了勘测笔记。
